audience: e-commerce sellers and small businesses that book parcel shipments with Eurosender

useCases.title: Compare shipping prices before you book
useCases.text: List the countries Eurosender ships to, then get the service types and prices for a parcel. Prices are in EUR. The quote creates no order.

useCases.title: Find the cities and regions an address needs
useCases.text: List the supported cities and regions of one country. Use the city or region id in an address when the name is not exact.

useCases.title: Book a shipment after the customer approves it
useCases.text: Get a quote, then validate the order without booking. Booking needs an explicit confirmation and charges the shipment to the Eurosender account.

useCases.title: Track parcels and download shipping labels
useCases.text: Read the live tracking checkpoints of each parcel in an order. Download the shipping label as PDF. Labels above the size limit are not returned.

useCases.title: Cancel an order after you check its status
useCases.text: Read the tracking status first. Then cancel the order. Eurosender decides whether the cancel is allowed and what it costs.
